params.feed: 0..1 card slides tray -> inside the reader (0.5) -> out on the landing spot (1)
params.search: 0..1 a yellow marker steps through the 9 drawers in reading order; each pops out as it passes
params.found: 0..1 the match drawer (middle row, right) pulls out and shows a yellow case card
params.ok: 0..1 lamp lights green; the stamp comes down and leaves a green check
params.bad: 0..1 lamp lights red; the stamp comes down and leaves a red X; the card turns red
